svg.text: mesh-msg handheld, Model S — schematic overview (rev A draft)
ESP32-S3 + 3.5" SPI touchscreen. Decoupling capacitors, ESD parts and footprints are listed in docs/handheld.md, not drawn. Nets with the same label are connected.
16 MB flash · 8 MB PSRAM · Wi-Fi + BLE 5
pull-ups: 10k on INT lines, 2.2k on I2C
Side buttons on one ADC pin
SW53–SW55; ≈0.6 V, 1.3 V, 2.3 V; none pressed = 3.3 V
L76K GPS or A7670 LTE: fit one
MK1 analog MEMS mic (1µF series C)
AEC reference: speaker signal back into the right ADC
Rev A draft · 2026-11-13 · not for fabrication
Design notes, BOM and pin rules: docs/handheld.md
